stepExplanation: Using the genetic code: AUG = Methionine (Met) - also the start codon; GCA = Alanine (Ala); UUC = Phenylalanine (Phe); AAG = Lysine (Lys); UAA = Stop codon. The polypeptide is Met-Ala-Phe-Lys (4 amino acids, as translation stops at the stop codon).
stepBody: Using the mRNA sequence AUG GCA UUC AAG UAA, identify each codon and use the genetic code table to determine the amino acid sequence. Note: AUG is the start codon and UAA is a stop codon.
